title: Restriction of open extension by zero
statement:
For an open immersion $j$, the adjunction unit $M\to j^*j_!M$ is an
isomorphism on pro-etale module sheaves.

proof.text: Use the finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, schemes $U,X$, open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ and module sheaf $M$ of [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. By [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization], identify $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$ and $A_U$ with $A_X|_U$. Put $P_M$ for the presheaf defining $j_!M$. Every object $V\to U$ has its unique factorization through $U$, and every arrow between such objects is over $U$. The defining formula for $P_M$ therefore identifies $P_M|_U=M$ on values, restriction maps and coefficient actions.

source.place: Tag 03DI (sites-modules-lemma-extension-by-zero), direct-sum presheaf formula, specialized to the unique factorization of an open immersion; pro-etale application: Tag 09AE (proetale-definition-extension-zero).

proof.text: Write $q_M:P_M\to P_M^\#=j_!M$ for the module-sheafification map. Its underlying map is abelian sheafification by [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Apply [lem-cbc-sieve-slice-sheafification] to the underlying abelian presheaf, using the chosen small pro-etale site (or its small skeleton). It identifies $q_M|_U$ with the sheafification unit of $P_M|_U=M$. This last unit is invertible: its universal property gives a retraction from the identity map of the sheaf $M$, and uniqueness of factorization gives the other inverse identity. Hence $u_M=q_M|_U:M\to j^*j_!M$ is an isomorphism of abelian sheaves. It is $A_U$-linear because $q_M$ is linear; the inverse of a bijective linear map is linear, so $u_M$ is a module-sheaf isomorphism. Naturality of $q$ gives $(j^*j_!f)u_M=u_N f$ for every module-sheaf map $f:M\to N$.

source.place: pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility:382 and toSheafify_pullbackSheafificationCompatibility:391, applied through lem-cbc-sieve-slice-sheafification; underlying abelian sheafification and linearity: Stacks Tag 03CY (sites-modules-lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules).

proof.text: The functor $L=j_!$ is fully faithful, as follows directly from the same formulas. For a module-sheaf map $b:LM\to LN$, set $f=u_N^{-1}(j^*b)u_M:M\to N$. Then $bq_M=q_NP_f$: on objects over $U$ this is the displayed formula defining $f$, and on every other object both maps have source $P_M(V)=0$. Since $Lf$ is the sheafification of $P_f$, uniqueness in [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] gives $b=Lf$. If $Lf=Lg$, restricting and using the naturality identity in step 2 gives $u_N f=u_N g$, hence $f=g$. Thus $f\mapsto Lf$ is bijective on every Hom set.

source.place: Tag 03DI (sites-modules-lemma-extension-by-zero), proof: componentwise maps followed by unique module-sheafification factorization from Tag 03CY; explicit full-faithfulness calculation for the open subterminal case.

proof.text: Put $R=j^*$ and let $\eta,\varepsilon$ be the unit and counit of the adjunction $L\dashv R$ supplied by [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Fullness in step 3 gives $a:RLM\to M$ with $La=\varepsilon_{LM}$. The left triangle identity gives $L(a\eta_M)=\varepsilon_{LM}L\eta_M=\mathrm{id}_{LM}$, and faithfulness gives $a\eta_M=\mathrm{id}_M$. Naturality of $\eta$ and the right triangle identity give $\eta_M a=RL(a)\eta_{RLM}=R\varepsilon_{LM}\eta_{RLM}=\mathrm{id}_{RLM}$. Thus the actual adjunction unit $\eta_M$, irrespective of the presentation of the adjunction, has inverse $a$ and is an isomorphism.

Steps: (1) The extension presheaf restricted to U equals M. This follows from localization clauses (1), (2) and (4) and the extension formula; since j is a monomorphism, every arrow between objects over U is over U. (2) The slice-sheafification leaf explicitly states that it is compatible with the sheafification unit, and its hypotheses hold: the site is a small skeleton, the values are abelian groups, and the slice topology matches the localized site. So the restricted unit is the unit of the sheaf M, hence invertible; naturality also holds. (3) Full faithfulness of j_!: I checked the components, b q_M = q_N P_f holds, and uniqueness of factorization gives b = Lf. (4) The triangle-identity argument is correct and holds for any adjunction L ⊣ R.
